you.reason: Use a polite everyday pronoun; Vietnamese address depends on the relationship.

she.primaryMeaning: cô ấy / chị ấy / bà ấy
she.reason: Avoid the animal and personification senses as the beginner default.

they.reason: People or things; singular they needs context.

the.primaryMeaning: mạo từ xác định (thường không dịch riêng)
the.reason: No single Vietnamese word consistently translates the definite article.

is.reason: A form of be; auxiliary usage may not need a separate translation.

was.reason: Past form of be; the full sentence decides the Vietnamese wording.

were.reason: Past form of be; conditional uses need review.

meanings: trợ động từ (thường không dịch riêng)
do.reason: Retain the correct v3 main verb meaning and add the missing auxiliary explanation.

meanings: trợ động từ (thường không dịch riêng)
does.reason: Third-person form of do; avoid a grammatical-reference-only entry.

meanings: trợ động từ quá khứ (thường không dịch riêng)
did.reason: Past form of do; question and negative uses need context.

of.reason: Common preposition; quantity and partitive uses need context.

to.reason: Destination or infinitive marker; the existing resolver still applies.

for.reason: Recipient, reason, or duration; the existing resolver still applies.

with.reason: Everyday accompaniment; instrument uses need context.

bye.reason: Conversational farewell instead of unrelated senses.

please.reason: Request marker is common in this content; verb sense remains useful.

wifi.reason: Common modern vocabulary missing from the SQLite source.

wi-fi.reason: Hyphenated spelling used by the subtitle tokenizer.

cafe.reason: SQLite cafe references accented café; keep the learner-facing spelling.

oh.reason: Reaction depends on the sentence and tone.

i'm.reason: I am; translate with the following complement.

you're.reason: You are; translate with the following complement.

he's.primaryMeaning: anh ấy là / anh ấy đang / anh ấy đã
he's.reason: Ambiguous he is or he has; human review is required.

she's.primaryMeaning: cô ấy là / cô ấy đang / cô ấy đã
she's.reason: Ambiguous she is or she has; human review is required.

it's.primaryMeaning: nó là / nó đang / nó đã
it's.reason: Ambiguous it is or it has; human review is required.

we're.primaryMeaning: chúng tôi là / chúng tôi đang
we're.reason: We are; Vietnamese pronoun choice depends on who is included.

they're.reason: They are; translate with the following complement.

i'll.reason: I will; modal nuance needs context.

we'll.primaryMeaning: chúng tôi sẽ / chúng ta sẽ
we'll.reason: We will; pronoun choice needs context.

i'd.primaryMeaning: tôi muốn / tôi sẽ / tôi đã
i'd.reason: Ambiguous I would or I had; phrase overrides take priority.

i've.reason: I have; perfect constructions need full-sentence review.

don't.reason: Do not; statement and imperative uses differ.

doesn't.reason: Does not; translate with the verb.

didn't.reason: Did not; past time may already be clear from context.

can't.reason: Cannot; inability or prohibition depends on context.

isn't.reason: Is not; translate with the complement.

aren't.reason: Are not; translate with the complement.

what's.reason: Ambiguous what is or what has; cannot be accurately translated alone.

that's.reason: Ambiguous that is or that has; phrase overrides take priority.

there's.reason: Ambiguous there is or there has; review the full sentence.

my.reason: Core possessive missing from SQLite and v3.

which.reason: Question and relative-clause uses differ; missing from SQLite.

whose.reason: Question and relative-clause uses differ; missing from SQLite.

should.reason: SQLite only contains a dot; advice and expectation senses need context.

checkout.reason: Grocery and hotel contexts differ; missing noun in SQLite.

cheaper.reason: Comparative of cheap; retain the comparison rather than just the base gloss.

easier.reason: Comparative of easy; retain the comparison rather than just the base gloss.

nearest.reason: Superlative of near; retain the comparison rather than just the base gloss.

and.reason: The generic SQLite ranker wrongly promotes là; preserve the common conjunction meaning.

how.primaryMeaning: như thế nào / bằng cách nào
how.reason: The generic SQLite ranker wrongly promotes là; questions require context.

what.reason: Question word; avoid nào as the only beginner gloss.

your.reason: Use a polite everyday possessive instead of assuming the addressee is male.

we.reason: Whether the listener is included cannot be decided by dictionary ranking.

her.reason: Object pronoun and possessive determiner require context.

him.reason: The SQLite record is incorrectly tagged as a noun; avoid hắn as a beginner default.

his.primaryMeaning: của anh ấy / của ông ấy
his.reason: Possessive; address and reference depend on the person.

something.primaryMeaning: một thứ gì đó / một điều gì đó
something.reason: Correct the automatic điều này selection, which loses indefiniteness.

anything.primaryMeaning: bất cứ thứ gì / điều gì
anything.reason: Indefinite pronoun; negative and question wording depends on context.

would.primaryMeaning: sẽ (trong giả định hoặc lời nói gián tiếp)
would.reason: Avoid the unclear đã sẽ source gloss; requests and conditionals need context.

lights.reason: Reject the unrelated animal-lungs sense for the everyday plural; traffic lights needs the full phrase.

supermarket.reason: Shorten the outdated cửa hàng tự động explanation to the familiar modern term.

password.reason: Use the everyday computer/Wi-Fi term instead of từ bí mật.

reservation.primaryMeaning: sự đặt trước / việc đặt chỗ
reservation.reason: Promote the booking sense over reserved land; retain other common uses for review.

tomato.reason: Food sense first for learners; retain the plant sense.

chicken.reason: Correct the v3 adjective-first default while preserving the useful figurative alternative.

gym.primaryMeaning: phòng tập thể dục / phòng tập gym
gym.reason: Destination sense first; thể dục alone is unclear in go to the gym.

dairy.primaryMeaning: sữa và sản phẩm từ sữa
meanings: cửa hàng hoặc cơ sở sản xuất sữa
dairy.reason: Learner-friendly dairy-section meaning; exact POS and context still need review.

bored.reason: Distinguish feeling bored from something being boring (nhàm chán).

timer.primaryMeaning: đồng hồ hẹn giờ / bộ hẹn giờ
timer.reason: Device sense first; the automatic person sense does not fit set a timer.
